# Native method-call precondition isolation

Scratch-only selection couples local user-defined method-call checks with their
nonchecking procedure requires. Legacy mode retains checked procedure requires;
local mode retains the single mandatory local check. Old allocation requirements
and every other opt-in decision stay in the other family. No actual obligation
is omitted. The other family also controls preparation inside local replay;
that interaction must be recorded. Native current/legacy fidelity controls and
genuine false-entry controls are required. No normal workflow enables this
selector. It is a causal diagnostic, not a proposed product policy or acceptance.
